title: XamlKeys JSON report
description: The shape written by --json. schemaVersion only increases on a major release; new fields may be added without bumping it, so consumers must ignore fields they do not recognise.

summary.description: Counts, and — just as important — what this run could not see.

dialectMixed.description: The tree holds both WPF and WinUI projects, whose merge order is opposite. Each dictionary was resolved with its own project's rules.

coverage.description: Share of merged dictionaries that could be read. Below minCoverage the run exits 3, because 'unused' cannot be trusted.

suppressed.description: Hidden by ignore comments, config or a baseline.

unresolvedSites.description: References whose key is not a string (x:Type, x:Static).

invalidIgnores.description: Ignore comments with no reason. They suppress nothing.

dynamicKeySites.description: C# lookups that build the key at runtime.

frameworkKeyOverrides.description: Keys that redefine a framework-provided key (WinUI lightweight styling, System* resources). The framework's own templates read them, so they are never reported as unused.

unusedOnlyViaUnused.description: How many of the unused findings are keys referenced only from inside other unused resources (counted in 'unused' as well).

keysNamedInCode.description: Further keys counted as used because their exact name appears as an ordinary string (not a lookup argument) in the same project's C#, for example handed to a helper method. Never reported as unused.

dynamicKeysNamedInCode.description: DynamicResource/ThemeResource references whose key no XAML defines but whose name (or a name plus a composed suffix such as $"{x}75") appears as a string in C# -- keys added to resources at runtime. Not reported as dangling.

keyedDictionaries.description: Keyed ResourceDictionaries nested in a dictionary (<ResourceDictionary x:Key="Compact">). Treated as mutually exclusive alternatives the app merges at runtime; their keys count as defined.

libraryKeyOverrides.description: Keys that belong to a library and are redefined to restyle it: a library key overridden by another project of this tree (not reported as shadowed: the library's definition still wins for other consumers), or a {x:Static}/{ComponentResourceKey} key whose type is not in this tree's C# (that library's own templates read it; not reported as unused).

classBackedDictionaries.description: Dictionaries or Avalonia style files merged as an element (<local:MyTheme/>) whose class is defined by an x:Class file in this tree. Resolved instead of counted as external.

keysMatchingComposedLookups.description: Keys counted as used because they match the fixed start and end of a key C# composes at runtime ($"Icon{name}", "Icon" + name), within the same project. Never reported as unused.

keysNamedNearDynamicLookups.description: Keys counted as used because their name appears as a string literal in a C# file that looks resources up by variable. Never reported as unused.

libraryKeysNotChecked.description: Keys in library projects, not evaluated for usage.

unusedDefinitions.description: Definitions covered by the unused findings (one finding per key name).

counts.description: Per-kind counts. Keys are camelCase here; findings[].kind uses the kebab-case form.

file.description: Relative to the scan root, forward slashes.

related.description: The other end: the winner of a shadowing, the first of a duplicate, the definition an out-of-scope reference wanted.
